title_hu: Régmúlt: past perfect és elbeszélő idők
subtitle_hu: had done – a múlt előtti múlt

sections.body_hu: A past perfect (had + past participle) egy MÁSIK múltbeli esemény ELŐTT lezajlott cselekvést fejez ki.

examples.en: The train had left when we arrived.
She had eaten before I came.

sections.body_hu: Elbeszélésben a past perfect jelzi, mi történt korábban, a past simple a fő eseménysort. Gyakori szavak: before, after, already, when.

examples.en: After he had finished, he left.
I had never seen it before.

exercises.prompt_hu: When we arrived, the film ___ already started.
She ___ eaten before the guests came.
He had ___ the book before the exam.
By the time she called, I ___ already left the office.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect: 'had' + past participle a múltban megelőzött cselekvéshez.

exercises.prompt_hu: After he ___ finished his work, he went home.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect szerkezetben 'had' szükséges az előző cselekvéshez.

exercises.prompt_hu: They realized they ___ forgotten the keys at home.
Before the rain started, we ___ already finished playing.
exercises.explanation_hu: 'Before' jelzi, hogy a past perfect a múltbeli sorrend jelölésére szolgál.

exercises.prompt_hu: She told me she ___ never been to Paris before.
The train ___ left when we arrived at the station.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect continuous: 'had already' + múltbeli esemény.

exercises.prompt_hu: He said that he ___ seen that film three times.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect múltban történt cselekvésre: 'had' + seen.

exercises.prompt_hu: By noon, the children ___ eaten all the cake.
She ___ already called the doctor before her mother arrived.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect sorrend: 'had' jelzi az előbbi cselekvést.

exercises.prompt_hu: When the police arrived, the burglar ___ already escaped.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect: 'had' + escaped a korábban történt cselekvéshez.

exercises.prompt_hu: They didn't know that I ___ finished the project.
After she ___ washed the dishes, she watched TV.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect: 'had' + washed az első cselekvéshez.

exercises.prompt_hu: The teacher asked if we ___ done our homework.
I realized I ___ made a terrible mistake.
exercises.explanation_hu: Múltban történt felismerés: past perfect 'had' + made.

exercises.prompt_hu: Once they ___ arrived home, they unpacked their bags.
He mentioned that he ___ worked there for five years.
By the time the game ended, she ___ scored five goals.
exercises.explanation_hu: 'By the time' + past simple: past perfect 'had' + scored.

exercises.prompt_hu: They were surprised because nobody ___ warned them.
She didn't remember that she ___ seen him before.
When I opened the door, I realized someone ___ been inside.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect: 'had' + been az előző cselekvéshez.

exercises.prompt_hu: After we ___ discussed the plan, we decided to proceed.
The restaurant was full because the game ___started.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect: 'had just' + started múltbeli eseményt jelöl.

exercises.prompt_hu: He explained that he ___ lost his job months ago.
By evening, the snow ___ covered the entire garden.
The police found the window that the thief ___ broken.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect: 'had' + broken az elkövetett bűncselekmény jelölésére.

exercises.prompt_hu: She realized that she ___ forgotten to buy milk.
Before the film started, they ___ bought popcorn.
The children were tired because they ___ played all day.
When she arrived at the party, everyone ___ already left.
He didn't know that I ___ spoken to his boss.
After the rain ___ stopped, we went for a walk.
The doctor said that the patient ___ improved.
By the time I arrived, the meeting ___ already finished.
She was grateful because her friend ___ helped her.
The explorer claimed that he ___ discovered a new island.
Once they ___ finished university, they moved to the city.
He remembered that he ___ never told her the truth.
exercises.explanation_hu: Múltbeli emlékezet: past perfect 'had' + never + told.

exercises.prompt_hu: The coach was disappointed because the team ___ lost the game.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect: 'had' + lost az előző mérkőzésre.

exercises.prompt_hu: Before she became a doctor, she ___ studied for years.
When the police arrived, the suspect ___vanished.
The student confessed that he ___ cheated on the exam.
By midnight, they ___ already celebrated the victory.
She didn't realize that she ___ made the same mistake before.
The witness said that he ___ seen the accident.
After the king ___died, his son took the throne.
The teacher knew that the students ___ studied the material.
Before they moved to London, they ___ lived in a small village for ten years.
exercises.explanation_hu: Past perfect: két múltbeli esemény közül a korábbi 'had' + 3. alak, mert a vidéken való lakás a londoniak költözés ELŐTT történt.
